conditionMonitoringQueryLanguage.query: fetch ${MONITORED_RESOURCE}| filter ${OUTER_FILTER}| {metric ${METRIC_USAGE_TYPE}| filter ${QUOTA_USAGE_FILTER}${OPTIONAL_USAGE_QUERY}| align next_older(1d)| group_by [${GROUPING}], .max; metric ${METRIC_LIMIT_TYPE}| filter ${QUOTA_LIMIT_FILTER}| align next_older(1d)| group_by [${GROUPING}], .min}| ratio| every 1m| condition gt(val(), 0.8 '1')
